## Session Brief

* [V1: the patched reference at two budgets and a window decomposition](V1.md) - Run the seeded patched reference at two budgets and decompose σ by top window (both outside, one inside) on both sides, to attribute the 2 % gap.
* [V2: confirm the continuum deficit and its region](V2.md) - Give the top-free continuum's MadEvent deficit five fresh seeds and the paired iteration test, and run the decisive |cos θ_W| > 0.99 slice on both sides, so the uu_tt row can be documented as a measured reference-side defect.

## Session Report

* [V1 report: the u u~ > w+ b w- b~ $ t t~ gap is MadEvent under-integrating the top-free continuum](V1-report.md) - Diagnosis of the ~2 % gap on the on-shell-veto t t~ row: it is not in the veto, the patch or the top windows. The same deficit appears on the top-free process (/ t t~); a non-adaptive third estimator agrees with vibegraph and sits 1.9 % above MadEvent; MadEvent's own iterations, recombined with equal weights, move it up by 0.5-1.2 %.
* [V2 report: the top-free deficit is confirmed, and the |cos θ_W| > 0.99 slice does not hold it](V2-report.md) - Five fresh MadEvent seeds put the top-free continuum 2.0 % below vibegraph (8 σ, seed χ²/dof 4.4); equal-weight recombination closes 0.8 points of it. The decisive slice falsifies V1's region: MadEvent integrates both-W |cos θ| > 0.99 correctly in isolation and is still 1.5 % low on the complement. The deficit sits entirely in the three double-peripheral channels G7, G8, G9.
